about_blocks.text: Sunshine Coast Health Centre approach promotes an individual’s control over their own recovery process and combines evidence-based therapeutic modalities. For example, their Meaning-Centered Therapy program helps clients explore their personal values, goals, and vision for their future to pave the way for a fulfilling life after treatment. Sunshine Coast’s team recognizes that each client faces unique challenges, and they create customized treatment plans for each. They work closely with clients to establish goals, implement strategies, and monitor their progress.

about_blocks.text: Sunshine Coast Health Centre offers a range of treatment programs, including a primary care program, extended care program, and a recovery enhancement program. Each program is designed to accommodate the specific needs of clients and provide comprehensive treatment. They also provide options for individual therapy, group therapy, and family therapy. Sunshine Coast Health Centre’s amenities include comfortable private rooms, nutritious meals cooked on-site, indoor and outdoor fitness facilities, recreational activities, and more. They strive to make their clients comfortable in their new environment, and activities like swimming, hiking, and kayaking are part of the treatment program.

about_blocks.text: Sunshine Coast Health Centre offers comprehensive treatment options for individuals struggling with drug addiction, alcoholism, PTSD, and trauma. With a team of over 50 credentialed, certified, and licensed professionals on staff, the centre provides 24-hour medical care, psychology, psychiatry, nutrition and fitness support, and specialized body work to ensure clients receive the best possible care. The centre has an incredible track record and has helped over 4,492 individuals overcome their addictions and improve their mental health since 2004.

about_blocks.text: Unlike many rehabilitation centres, Sunshine Coast Health Centre does not rely solely on the traditional 12-step program. Instead, the centre utilizes evidence-based treatments to help guide clients towards recovery. The men’s program at the centre brings together a team of highly-trained professionals who work to provide support to motivated men struggling with their mental health. With a staff-to-client ratio of 3 to 1, clients can rest assured that their care will be personalized and comprehensive throughout their journey towards healing.
